What changes from the previous map?

The drainage mask follows the mapped upstream network. It does not select watersheds because they lie nearby. Turn on the gray legacy layer to compare the former polygons. HUC12 boundaries are reporting partitions, not independent inlet watersheds. Small boundary overlaps can reflect dataset alignment differences; do not substitute whole HUC12 polygons for the clipped drainage mask.

Built in GitHub Actions from public DWR and USGS sources. No local project files were created.
